label: Minimal Education
summary: Airy educational frames for definitions, step-by-step instruction, and structured comparison scenes.
description: Original Lucida family for concise teaching content with generous whitespace, crisp typography, and restrained semantic accents.
avoidFor: asset-led showcase scenes where media is the main subject
high-drama hook scenes that depend on oversized cinematic type
dense dashboards with real-time metrics or operational status panels
layoutGrammar: Keep one headline dominant and leave visible breathing room around each teaching block.
Use surfaces sparingly; default to rules, spacing, and small accent marks before adding panels.
Apply multiple accent hues only as semantic guidance, never as competing decorative fields.
When density rises, preserve alignment first and reduce type scale second.
Reduced motion swaps travel-heavy movement for opacity-first reveals.

sourcePolicy.notes: The package uses original Lucida layouts, original fixture copy, and shared core tokens only. No third-party logos, screenshots, or copied brand systems are registered.

notes: Rendered through a standalone family composition because shared registry and root integrations are outside this ownership scope.
Metadata includes 16:9 compatibility for later QA, but this wave only renders portrait review frames.
